crossRefs.note: He gave her his hand, and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.
He came and took her by the hand, and raised her up. The fever left her immediately, and she served them.
Taking the child by the hand, he said to her, “Talitha cumi!” which means, being interpreted, “Girl, I tell you, get…
But Jesus took him by the hand, and raised him up; and he arose.
He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight and glorified God.

translations.web: He took him by the right hand and raised him up. Immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.
translations.bsb: Taking him by the right hand, Peter helped him up, and at once the man’s feet and ankles were made strong.
translations.kjv: And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength.
translations.asv: And he took him by the right hand, and raised him up: and immediately his feet and his ankle-bones received strength.
